 Sunderland vs Brentford: Latest Carabao Cup Team News and Predicted Lineups 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 Last Word on Football brings you the latest team news and the predicted lineups ahead of the Sunderland vs Brentford League Cup clash on Wednesday.
 The Black Cats, due to playing in the Europa League, began the competition in round three, where they dispatched Hull City 1-0. The Bees, on the other hand, have played twice, beating Birmingham City 6-1 in round two, followed by a 2-1 win over Reading.
 Despite a place in the quarterfinals, the prize for the winner, both head coaches are expected to make changes to their EPL teams,
 Sunderland vs Brentford Carabao Cup Fourth Round Team News and Predicted Lineups
 Date: October 28, 2026
 Venue: Stadium of Light
 Kick-off: 7:45 pm
 Last Meeting: Brentford 1-1 Sunderland, Premier League, September 5
 Referee: Gavin Ward
 Current odds: Sunderland 21/10, Draw 12/5, Brentford 19/20
 Sunderland Team News
 Chemsdine Talbi of Sunderland during the Sunderland v Leeds United Premier League match at the Stadium of Light. Credit IMAGO / Every Second Media 
 Defender Dan Ballard remains unavailable, as does winger Romaine Mundle, while striker Wilson Isidor is once again a major doubt, having missed the last four games. At best, he could make the bench.
 Thomas Meunier is expected to be available, having missed the last four, but like Isidor, is likely to start from the bench should he be passed fit. Centre back Kevin Danso is available, however, having served his suspension for his sending off at Bournemouth.
 Head coach Regis Le Bris is expected to ring the changes with the likes of fan favourite Chemsdine Talbi and fellow winger Malik Fofana, midfielders Habib Diarra and Jules Ahoka, fullback Dayann Methalie, and centreback Omar Alderete all expected to start.
 “It won’t be a friendly game at all, we want to win it with the players available
and to get ready for the next Premier League game against Coventry.” 
 Regis Le Bris 
 Brentford Team News
 Brentford head coach Keith Andrews. Credit IMAGO / APL 
 The Bees will be without defender Rico Henry after he picked up a hip and quad injury a few weeks ago in training. He is not expected back for several weeks.
Yehor Yarmolyuk will also be missing as he continues to serve a suspension following his red card against Liverpool. Striker Kaye Furo is also out. He has been missing due to a metatarsal injury, but despite being back in training, this game will come too soon.
 Long-term absentee Antoni Milambo is nearing a return after recovering from an ACL injury; however, the best he can hope for is a place on the bench.
 Josh Dasilva began training ahead of the recent Hull fixture, but is a major doubt, having not featured so far this season. Vitaly Janelt is available, having served a one-game ban.
 We want to go as far as we can go in this competition, and there’s no reason that we can’t,
 but we’ve got a very difficult game tomorrow.” 
 Keith Andrews ahead Carabao Cup game at Sunderland

 The Last Word on Sunderland vs Brentford
 Both teams are expected to be changed significantly from those at the weekend. The Carabao Cup, until the latter stages at least, is a competition to give squad members a chance to impress and gain vital minutes in case needed elsewhere as the season progresses. That said, neither team will be fielding poor teams and there will be plenty of quality on show for those in attendance.
 Sunderland, following their unbeaten start in Europe ending their four game run of defeats in the league against Leeds will be hoping to gain momentum and more confidence ahead of their trip to Coventry this weekend.
 Brentford are chasing another Carabao Cup quarterfinal to add to their good start to the season that sees them sit sixth in the Premier League table after the first eight games.
 Prediction: 2-2. Match to be decided by penalties.
